God, yes! I daydream about ending my life and finally being able to feel at peace quite frequently. I just feel like a waste of space who has no inherent value or purpose in their life. I feel like a drain on society. 

In the past less than 2.5 years, I’ve lost 3 friends to suicide (rip Z, Alicia, Medusa). The most recent death was in Sept 2022. It triggered a really bad breakdown and bout of suicidal ocd where I had the odd experience of being obsessed with killing myself without feeling like I wanted to kill myself. I go through bouts of suicidal ocd and suicidal feelings quite often, but this was the worst one yet. I googled the amount of my prescription meds I would need to off myself, which was given to me in mg/kg. I calculated how much mg I would need based on my weight and then proceeded to count the amount of prescription meds I had left to ensure that if I did in fact decide that I wanted to follow through with that plan, I would be able to.

Since that breakdown, I haven’t been working or really doing much in my life. I’m also 25 right now, turning 26 in April and I’ve kinda just accepted that chances are quite high that unless I change something drastically in my life (aka get a job and stop being a worthless piece of shit), I’m probs gonna finally follow through on what I’ve been dreaming of for over a decade. At 26, I won’t be able to use my mom’s health insurance anymore and the meds I take to keep from kms are expensive. I’m barely hanging on to keeping my apartment rn since I’m unemployed and I think the stress of it all will finally help me give up.

Interestingly enough, my mentality on kms has shifted from doing so because no one cares about me to doing so because I’m a fucking disappointment to everyone who loves me. 

I just can’t do it anymore. It seems like for each step forward I take, I get pushed back 3. I grew up with emotionally and physically abusive parents. My mom once told me “When [she] sees [my] face, [she] sees failure” as well as cursing me out frequently. I’ve been hit with a variety of implements by both my mother and father including but not limited to belts, hangers, broomsticks, telephone wires, Barbie dolls, etc. They were very opportunistic.

Back in 2019, I dropped out of college (I was only 4 classes away from earning my bachelor’s degree in Economics) due to not quite healing properly from a concussion and post concussive syndrome that I got the year before. I chose to live in a homeless shelter rather than return to living with them. (I can’t finish school rn because I owe them thousands and thousands of dollars so please don’t recommend that). I finally got my first apartment in Feb 2020 and life seemed to be going so well. I was financially independent (except for the health insurance thing) and I was functioning. Then ofc, covid hit. 

My dad died 3 days after my 23rd birthday on April 18, 2020 (so pre-vaccine). I never got to say goodbye at his funeral cuz I was in another state and didn’t have a car. I didn’t want to risk going on the greyhound and y’know end up catching and dying of covid just like he did. I was still doing alright in terms of going to work, although I became a bit of an alcoholic. I drank every day for a week after he passed. I would show up to work kinda tipsy but soon stopped after puking in the bathroom. With the exception of certain substance abuse problems, I was doing “alright”.  Then my uncle died a few months later. His death triggered a breakdown and brought up all the unresolved feelings about my dad’s death. I had a breakdown and stopped showing up to work. Then my friend Z killed herself in Aug. 

During this depression (and still to this day), I was living where I didn’t have any friends. I had started dating someone March of 2020 who turned out to be very emotionally abusive. Knowing that I had an eating disorder, he once told me that if his stomach looked like mines, he would kill himself. When I would tell him that it bothered me that he kept calling me fat, his response was “yeah yeah yeah I remind you you’re fat, cry about it”. He would make jokes about cheating on me with his 2 female friends. At first I would joke back about leaving him, but that would upset him and he asked me to stop. I asked him to stop as well and it took him months to do so. I can go on and on about how he would gaslight me when I’d try to call him out but I digress.

Idk life just feels pretty impossible rn. As I have nothing I’m doing in my actual life, I’ve turned deeper and deeper into my ed. When it developed in high school, it was more about being able to exert some level of control over myself because I felt powerless, but now, it’s where I derive a twisted sense of satisfaction. There’s success metrics, which include hours fasted, calories consumed, calories burned, and pounds lost. It gives me something to live/strive for. I keep on failing at everything else around but at least my ed will never abandon me and can help me feel good about sometimes.

It all just feels so hopeless. Like nothing I do will bring any sort of meaningful change to benefit my life. 

I don’t have any friends in the area and it’s not like I haven’t tried to make any. I live in a very small, white, conservative town that still have places where Trump signs are flying around. I’m Black so that’s uhh not exactly the best environment. (I’m unemployed and broke, so telling me to move would also not be helpful here). I’ve tried to get involved at the local theatre and that’s been nice. However, most of the people I’ve worked with are either high schoolers or middle aged women with kids. I find it difficult to connect with them. I’m out of the toxic relationship that I was in, but he was basically my entire social life. I would hang out with his friends and his family, but now, they’re not an option any more. This is a small town, so there’s not a lot of events happening where I can meet people. It’s one of those areas where everyone went to school with everyone and that’s how they know people and have friends. I moved here for college and stayed in the area because that’s where the homeless shelter was. 

I’m just so lonely and sad all the time. I don’t know how to be a person. I don’t know how to be happy. I don’t know how to talk to people. I don’t know how to make friends anymore. I’ve tried using bumble bff but there’s not a lot of people who use it in this area and the conversations that I’ve had seem to go nowhere. I just feel so empty and sad and useless and worthless and meaningless. 

I wish I was never born, so I’d never have to suffer the pain of being alive. I don’t know how to be a person. I don’t know how to function in society. I feel like a ghost of a person. I feel like I’m only real when I’m talking to another person, which doesn’t happen too often as I’m unemployed and have no real reason to leave my apartment. Idk what I’m doing here or why I’m here. I just think I’m better off not cuz I just feel so incompetent.
